answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because jetty only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
